about: The type scale: every component draws text in one of these roles (Tailwind classes text-hero, text-lead, text-title, text-body, text-label, text-unit, text-caption via ui/preset.css), never its own px. type-floor is the smallest text anywhere on screen, zoom included (morc tree flags `tiny` below it). Sizes from docs/theme-rules.md (card text 15, hero 32-36, row title 13, detail 11.5). Override in prefs/tokens/type.json. type-<role> is the size to use: the same on screen in every card whatever its zoom (importance and size_bias scale the card, never its type), never under the floor; type-<role>-weight its weight.
